property_summary: For every call to transfer, the reference contract accepts any non-empty _tos array (length >=1) and therefore completes (returns true) for at least those inputs; the mutant requiring _tos.length > 1 rejects calls with exactly one recipient, so there exist inputs (a single-recipient array) where the reference succeeds but the mutant reverts.
change_summary: Require that _tos.length >= 1 changed to require(_tos.length > 1) so calls with exactly one recipient will revert, altering observed success for those inputs.
